CT ABDOMEN WITHOUT CONTRAST

INDICATION: The patient is a 52-year-old female in whom evaluation for pulmonary embolism has been requested.

COMPARISON: No prior examinations are available for comparison.

FINDINGS:
Lung bases: Within the limited portions of the lung bases included on this examination, there is what appears to be an 8 mm part-solid pulmonary nodule situated in the right middle lobe, the solid component of which measures approximately 3 mm in dimension. No consolidation is identified in the imaged lung bases.

Additional findings: The adrenal glands appear normal in their morphology. The cardiac silhouette is normal in size. Coronary artery calcifications are present. There is no pleural effusion, and no pneumothorax is identified.

IMPRESSION:
1. No acute abnormality is identified on this examination.
2. An 8 mm part-solid nodule is present in the right middle lobe, for which follow-up CT of the chest in 3 to 6 months is suggested.
